================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO MŌ AFTER EFFECTS - HE AHA TE HOU
Putanga 9.2.8  -  Oketopa 2026
================================================================================

E kōrero ana te papa i ngā REO 132 ināianei, kua tae mai ngā ĀHUA DEMON SLAYER hou me tētahi hoari
e tapahi ana i ngā pātene e pēhia ana e koe, me ētahi whakatika whakatakotoranga me Windows.

I MUA I TE TĪMATA
- Tāutahia ki runga i tō putanga o ināianei mā tāu kaitāuta ZXP e whakamahi ai i ngā wā katoa,
  ā, tīmata anōtia a After Effects i te kotahi.
- Ka mau tonu āu tautuhinga, tō āhua, ō tautuhinga tōmua me ō kīanga kua tiakina.

HOU: TE PAPA KI NGĀ REO 132
- Kei Ngā Tautuhinga Flex > REO ināianei te rārangi o ngā reo 132, me tētahi pouaka rapu. Kōwhiria
  tētahi, ā, ka huri te papa katoa: ngā ripa, ngā pātene, ngā tohutohu me ngā karere.
- Kua whakamāoritia ia reo e te AI mai i te papa reo Ingarihi, kaua i te kupu ki te kupu. Ko ngā
  ingoa e kitea ana e koe i tāu kaupapa (ngā ingoa paparanga, ngā ingoa pānga) ka noho tonu ki te
  reo Ingarihi kia ōrite tonu ki After Effects.
- Kua whakamāoritia hoki te wini puta “He aha te hou”, mai i tēnei putanga ā muri ake nei.

HOU: NGĀ ĀHUA DEMON SLAYER
- Kei Ngā Tautuhinga Flex > KAIKŌWHIRI ĀHUA tētahi rōpū DEMON SLAYER hou me ngā āhua 11:
  Giyu, Hinokami Kagura, Shinobu, Mitsuri, Rengoku, Zenitsu, Nezuko,
  Muichiro, Inosuke, Tengen me Kokushibo.
- Nekehia te kiore ki runga i te papa, ā, ka whai te huānga o te āhua i a ia: te wai,
  ngā mura, te uira, ngā pūrerehua, ngā rau puāwai, te kohu me te maha atu. Ina tū te
  kiore, ka memeha atu.
- Pāwhiria tētahi pātene, ā, ka tapahia e te hoari o taua tangata. Mēnā ka pupuri tonu koe i te pātene
  mauī ka tapahi tonu; pupuri mō te 2.5 hēkona pea, ā, ka pahū.
- I hangaia kia mama tonu: ka rere noa ngā pānga i te wā e neke ana, e pāwhiri ana rānei koe, ā, ka
  mama ake anō i runga i ngā rorohiko puhoi ake. Whakawetohia NGĀ PĀNGA TAIAO
  i te Kaikōwhiri Āhua kia toe noa ai ngā tae.

KUA WHAKAREREKĒ: NGĀ PĀTENE PAPATAHI KI ĀHUA KATOA
- Ko ngā pātene hohe me ngā pātene matua i roto i ngā āhua tae kāore anō e whakamahi i tētahi
  hekenga tae whakamarumaru mai i runga ki raro. He tae papatahi kotahi me tētahi kānapa ngāwari,
  nō reira he mā ake te āhua, he pai ake te pānui.

KUA WHAKATIKAHIA
- I taea e te kāri raihana me te wini puta “He aha te hou” te tuhera i runga i tētahi i tētahi.
  Ināianei e kore rāua e kapi i a rāua anō, ā, e kore te tohu WHAKAHOUNGA e kapi i ngā
  pātene kei te tihi o te papa.
- Ki te TAUINE UI 125% me te 150%, i taea e ētahi wini (pēnei i Ngā Tautuhinga Flex) te tipu teitei ake
  i te papa, nō reira ka ngaro atu te pātene katinga i te tirohanga. Ināianei ka pai ngā wini katoa
  ki ia rahi.
- Windows: I taea e AutoCaptions te kī “KUA TAWHITO RAWA TE KAITARAIWA NVIDIA MŌ NGĀ TAPANGA
  GPU” i runga i ngā kāri me ngā kaitaraiwa hou (ngā raupapa RTX 40 me 50). Ināianei ka pānui tika
  i te tautoko CUDA a te kaitaraiwa, ā, ka whakamahi i tō GPU.

KĀORE I REREKĒ
- Ka mahi pēnei tonu te raihana, te whakahohe me ia hono pēnei i mua.
- Ka mahi pēnei tonu ētahi atu ripa me ngā taputapu katoa pēnei i te 9.2.7.
================================================================================

FLEX ULTIMATE MŌ PREMIERE PRO - HE AHA TE HOU
Putanga 2.2.8  -  Oketopa 2026

Ko ngā tapanga CAPTION STACK he tauira Motion Graphics ka taea te WHAKATIKA ināianei, me tētahi
kaiwhakatika tūturu, kua tae mai he AUDIO STUDIO hou me MARK AUDIO BEATS, e kōrero ana te papa i ngā
REO 132, kua tae mai te TAUINE UI ki ULTIMATE, me ngā ĀHUA DEMON SLAYER hou.

I MUA I TE TĪMATA
- Tāutahia ki runga i tō putanga o ināianei mā tāu kaitāuta ZXP e whakamahi ai i ngā wā katoa,
  ā, tīmata anōtia a Premiere Pro i te kotahi.
- Ka mau tonu āu tautuhinga, tō āhua me ō tautuhinga tōmua.

HOU: CAPTION STACK - NGĀ TAPANGA KA TAEA TE WHAKATIKA (FX & ADV RIGS > CAPTION STACK)
- Ka whakanohoia ngā tapanga hei tauira Motion Graphics ka taea te whakatika ināianei (Putanga >
  MOGRT WHAKATIKA, te taunoa hou i Premiere Pro 2026). Whai muri i te whakanoho, whakarerekētia tētahi kupu,
  momotuhi, tae, rahi, tūnga, kānapa, taitapa, pouaka,
  nekehanga, wā rānei i te papa Essential Graphics a Premiere.
- Ka whakanoho tonu te Putanga > PIKITIA i ia kupu hei pikitia me te āhua ōrite rawa,
  mēnā he pai ake tērā ki a koe.
- Kei roto i te papa ngā tauira. Kāore he mea hei tikiake.

HOU: KAIWHAKATIKA CAPTION STACK
- Ināianei e whakaatu ana te tirohanga tōmua i te anga tūturu o tō ataata i raro i ia tapanga.
- Toia tētahi tapanga hei nekeneke i a ia, whakamahia te kokonga hei whakarerekē i te rahi me te ira o runga hei
  hurihuri, pāwhiri-rua i tētahi kupu hei whakatika. Ko TAPANGA KATOA e nekeneke ana i ia kupu ngātahi,
  ko TE KUPU KOTAHI e nekeneke ana i tētahi kupu kotahi.
- Kōwhiria mēnā ka pā tētahi huringa ki ia tapanga, ki tēnei tapanga anake rānei, ā, tiakina ō
  whakatakotoranga kia whakamahia anōtia.
- 10 āhua GLOW hou: Big Wide, Bounce Lime, Candy, Horror, Hook, Typewriter,
  Editorial, Sunset, Slide Yellow me Superb.

HOU: AUDIO STUDIO (FX & ADV RIGS > AUDIO STUDIO)
- Kōwhiria tētahi wāhanga oro, tīpakohia tētahi pānga, ā, pēhia WHAKAMAHIA. Ka rere katoa i runga i tō
  rorohiko.
- 30 tautuhinga tōmua pāwhiri-kotahi: Raro i te Wai, Bass Boost, Reverb Rūma / Wharenui / Whare Karakia /
  Pereti, Whakahoki Reo, Waea, Irirangi, Megaphone, Karetao, Chipmunk, Reo
  Hōhonu, Nightcore, Slowed + Reverb, 8D Audio, Lo-fi, Whakamuri me te maha atu. Tāpirihia
  ngā pānga e hia noa ana, whakaraupapahia anōtia, whakawetohia rānei tētahi.
- Ka mau tonu i te Reverb tōna hiku: ka pāoro te oro ki tua atu i te mutunga o te wāhanga, ā, ka
  whakanohoia kia kore ai tētahi mea i runga i tō rārangi wā e whakakapia.
- Ngā taputapu: Kaiwhakakore Haruru, Whakapai Reo, Te Kaha o te Oro (-14 / -16 / -23 LUFS),
  De-esser, De-click, De-clip, Kaiwhakakore Hum, Compressor, Limiter, EQ, Tere
  me te Teitei, Noise Gate, Tango Oro.
- Ka wehe a STEMS MAKER i tētahi waiata ki te reo me te puoro (ki ngā stem 4 rānei). Ka tikiake i tōna
  tauira i te wā tuatahi, ā, ka pātai tuatahi ki a koe.
- Mā TE TIROHANGA TŌMUA e rongo koe i te 8 hēkona pea me tētahi pana Taketake / Kua Tukatukahia.
  Ka haere te hua ki tētahi ara oro wātea, ā, ka whakamutua te oro o tō wāhanga taketake,
  kāore rawa e mukua.

HOU: MARK AUDIO BEATS (FX & ADV RIGS > MARK AUDIO BEATS)
- Kōwhiria tētahi wāhanga puoro i te rārangi wā, ā, pēhia MARK BEATS: ka kimi a Flex i ngā pao
  ka tāpiri i ngā tohu raupapa ki runga, kia piri tika ai ō tapatapahi ki te
  puoro.
- Kōwhiria NGĀ PAO KATOA, NGĀ KICK, NGĀ SNARE rānei, tautuhia te rongo, ā, tohua ia pao, ia pao tuarua,
  ia pao tuawhā rānei.
- Ka mukua e TANGOHIA NGĀ TOHU PAO ngā tohu anake i tāpiria e Flex. Ka rere i runga i tō
  rorohiko.

HOU: TAUINE UI
- Mā Ngā Tautuhinga > TAUINE UI e nui ake, e iti ake rānei te papa katoa, pēnei i Flex GUI Pro.
  Ka pai ngā wini katoa ki ia rahi.
